profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: I have been a software engineer for more than 5 years. While my experience includes native iOS and android development as well as full stack web development, my most recent tech stack at my current position as a Senior Software Engineer at Stem includes Django and React (Python, Javascript and Typescript). I’ve been developing financial tools for musicians and artists for a couple of years, through which I’ve developed my passion for technology in the music space as well as in the financial space.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
- Played a key role in architecting a royalty processing platform that ingests sales and costs data from record labels to determine owed artist payments.

- Enhanced operational efficiency by integrating with a third-party royalty processing platform via their APIs, automating manual file transfers.

- Collaborated on a full-stack app optimizing payment experiences for record labels. Integrated Stripe with our Django backend and React frontend.

- Developed data visualizations and insights to demystify artists' sales and costs, contributing to both the frontend and API.

- Launched a Spotify pre-save service for artists using Django, React, and Spotify's API.

- Interviewed 50+ engineering candidates, aiding in team expansion from 4 to 17 engineers.

- Consistently engaged in paired programming to support colleagues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the creation of customizable e-commerce stores for clients, enhancing user experience by integrating their catalog data seamlessly.

- Independently developed a custom form builder using React and Ruby on Rails.

- Created an applicant portal powered by custom forms tailored by clients.

- Engineered a rewards framework integrating both Stripe and iOS In-App Purchases.

- Continuously improved and maintained the company’s iOS and Android applications.

- Progressed to a software engineer role, mastering Git, adopting agile methodologies, and participating in on-call rotations alongside a dynamic team
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Android Development · Java · Swift · iOS Development · Ruby on Rails · React.js

positions.title: Global Product Technology Intern - Application Developer
positions.description:
As a Global Product Technology intern at ADP, I joined the Talent Management Solutions (TMS) team. During my time as part of this team, developed a Java web application that allows other TMS Software Developers to view and change log levels of TMS java web applications during runtime. This application handles log changes for local instances of TMS applications, but also the propagation of a log level changes throughout any and all servers running TMS applications simultaneously. I achieved the following goals whilst developing this application:

 • Conducted the development of the application using Eclipse and Java EE 6.
 • Managed dependencies and building with Apache Maven.
 • Deployed and ran the application using Apache Tomcat.
 • Utilized frameworks and libraries including but not limited to HttpServlet, Java Messaging Service, IBM Websphere MQ, Apache Log4J.
 • Handled dependency injection with the Spring framework.
 • Used HTML, CSS, and Javascript for designing a clean modern user interface and user experience.
 • Employed proper version control using Git and Bitbucket.
 • Achieved continuous integration with Jenkins.
 • Documented the code using Javadocs and traditional in-line comments.
 • Wrote a step-by-step guide on how to use the tool with other applications as well as documentation of the tool’s technical background and components.

positions.title: Cabin Avionics Engineering Co-op
positions.locationName: 1775 M H Jackson Service Rd, Atlanta, GA 30354
positions.description:
As part of the Interiors Engineering department at Delta Air Lines Technical Operations, I've been able to aid in numerous projects as well as develop the necessary skills to take on projects independently in the near future.

My biggest contribution so far has been in the implementation of Gogo Inc's latest in-flight internet technology, 2KU, on Delta's B737-800 fleet.  I've aided in design decisions, troubleshooting, and documentation.

positions.title: iOS Team Leader - Brain Trauma Assessment Protocols
positions.description:
The Brain Trauma Assessment Protocols project is the continuation of my previous research experience at the Opportunity Research Scholars program.  Our team grew from 3 to 8 students, and the project has been transferred to the Vertically Integrated Projects program.

Our current priority as research assistants working in the Brain Trauma Assessment Protocols project consists of developing a mobile data collection application for both the Android and iOS platform.  As the iOS development team leader, I've focused my efforts in designing the program architecture of the application itself. Using Swift and Xcode, I designed most of the application's elements and user interface, consisting of several view controllers, many of which I delegated to my teammates. Furthermore, we used GitHub to seamlessly merge all of our collaborations. Through team meetings and effective communication, we were able to create the first prototype of the application.

Note: Due to the private nature of this project, I am not allowed to disclose the source files.

company.name: Vertically Integrated Projects - Brain Trauma Assessment Protocols

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description: As an electrical engineering intern at Sto Corp, I was able to work on several important projects, and gained experience in the engineering of the construction materials manufacturing industry.  One of the projects I worked on included the standardization of the pallet design across all three of Sto Corp US plants.  I was also involved development and implementation of a program for generating custom barcodes for all Sto Corp products.  One of the major projects was taking on the challenge of improving and updating the equipment calibrations database system and developed a new protocol for its maintenance.  And of course, I aided in the in the troubleshooting of electrical components of the newly implemented automation systems.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Speech recognition and analysis has been used to diagnose depression among patients.  However, it hasn't been explored or researched in depth with patients suffering from Aphasia, a language disorder, mainly caused by strokes.

As an Opportunity Research Scholar working with Dr. Elliot Moore and Stephanie Gillespie, I was responsible of engaging in a literature review and writing the segment on data entry methods of our project proposal, and developing a mobile data collection application for the iOS platform with the purpose of providing a constant stream of analyzable data to the lab environment, rather than the much slower process of having samples delivered monthly.

The project was transferred to a different research program and renamed "Brain Trauma Assessment Protocols", for which I served as iOS Development Team Leader.
